tagline: Adds 3rds, 5ths and octaves above or below each note
description: Passes each incoming note through and adds harmony notes at a third, fifth or octave above or below it. In Chromatic mode the third is a major third and the fifth a perfect fifth; the in-key scale modes are intended to pick diatonic intervals, but their scale lookup currently gives wrong intervals, so check results by ear. Built as a MIDI effect, so Ableton Live will not load it; use a host that accepts third-party MIDI effects.

features.name: Six harmony voices
features.description: Switch on a 3rd, 5th or octave above, and a 3rd, 5th or octave below, in any combination.

features.name: Key and scale
features.description: Twelve keys and 13 scale choices: Chromatic, Major, Minor, the modes, Harmonic and Melodic Minor, Pentatonic and Blues.

features.name: Mix
features.description: Scales the velocity of the harmony notes from 0 to 100%; the original note is always played.

features.name: Velocity
features.description: Harmony notes use the played velocity or a fixed velocity from 1 to 127.

features.name: MIDI learn
features.description: The Mix and Fixed Velocity sliders can be assigned to a MIDI controller.
